say:2:1710816002:1.text: He... he actually brought the Princess back!
say:2:1710816002:1.source_cn: 他、他真的……他把公主殿下带回来了！

say:3:1710816003:1.text: Oh! A miracle! No, a blessing from the goddess!

say:30:1710816021:1.source_cn: 看看他！看看我们的奥利安王子！

say:31:1710816022:1.text: Fearless in danger! Slayer of monsters! He brought back the Hall of Ancients and the Princess!
say:31:1710816022:1.source_cn: 临危不惧！斩杀魔物！带回圣古堂和公主了！

say:32:1710816023:1.text: He is the Empire's true heir!
say:32:1710816023:1.source_cn: 他！才是我们耀光真正的继承人！！！

say:36:1710816025:1.text: The crowd's gaze shifts unconsciously from the Prince... to what stands before him on the steps—
say:36:1710816025:1.source_cn: 人们的目光，下意识地从王子身上，移向了他身前……那把台...

say:42:1710816028:1.text: Prince Orion has passed the trial! He has saved us!
say:42:1710816028:1.source_cn: 奥利安王子通过了试炼！他拯救了我们！

say:49:1710816032:0.text: Draw the sword! Draw the sword!

say:51:1710816033:1.text: People of the Empire! By Dura's grace, and by your will...
say:51:1710816033:1.source_cn: 耀光的子民们！艾雅和你们的意志——

choice:24:0:1.text: Then we need a greater legend to shatter this one.
